armors.name: Padded Armor
armors.description: Padded armor consists of quilted layers of cloth and batting.

armors.name: Leather Armor
armors.description: The breastplate and shoulder protectors of this armor are made of leather that has been stiffened by being boiled in oil.

armors.name: Studded Leather Armor
armors.description: Made from tough but flexible leather, studded leather is reinforced with close-set rivets or spikes.

armors.name: Hide Armor
armors.description: A crude armor made from thick furs and pelts.

armors.name: Chain Shirt
armors.description: Made of interlocking metal rings, a chain shirt is worn between layers of clothing or leather.

armors.name: Scale Mail
armors.description: This armor consists of a coat and leggings of leather covered with overlapping pieces of scale-shaped metal.

armors.name: Breastplate
armors.description: A fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather. It provides good protection without hindering movement.

armors.name: Half Plate
armors.description: Half plate consists of shaped metal plates that cover most of the wearer's body.

armors.name: Ring Mail
armors.description: Leather armor with heavy rings sewn into it.

armors.name: Chain Mail
armors.description: Made of interlocking metal rings, chain mail includes a gauntlet and padded undergarment.

armors.name: Splint Armor
armors.description: This armor is made of narrow vertical strips of metal riveted to a backing of leather.

armors.name: Plate Armor
armors.description: Interlocking shaped steel plates that cover the entire body. The pinnacle of non-magical protection.

armors.name: Shield
armors.description: A wooden or metal shield carried in one hand. Wielding a shield increases Armor Class by 2.

weapons.name: Dagger
weapons.description: A balanced, easily concealed blade favored by rogues and sorcerers.

weapons.name: Handaxe
weapons.description: A light wood-chopping axe balanced for melee combat or throwing.

weapons.name: Mace
weapons.description: A heavy flanged iron head affixed to a reinforced shaft.

weapons.name: Quarterstaff
weapons.description: A six-foot length of seasoned ash or oak, often serving as an arcane focus.

weapons.name: Spear
weapons.description: A wooden haft tipped with a sharpened leaf-shaped steel head.

weapons.name: Light Crossbow
weapons.description: A mechanical bow mounted on a wooden stock with a lever draw.

weapons.name: Shortbow
weapons.description: A compact curved wooden bow ideal for skirmishing and ambush.

weapons.name: Battleaxe
weapons.description: A broad, bearded axe head capable of cleaving through shields and mail.

weapons.name: Greatsword
weapons.description: A massive two-handed sword with a double-edged blade over four feet long.

weapons.name: Greataxe
weapons.description: A brutal, broad-headed executioner's axe favored by barbarians.

weapons.name: Longsword
weapons.description: The quintessential weapon of knights, versatile for one-handed or two-handed strikes.

weapons.name: Rapier
weapons.description: A slender, sharply pointed blade designed for thrusting with agility.

weapons.name: Scimitar
weapons.description: A curved, single-edged blade designed for swift slashing manoeuvres.

weapons.name: Shortsword
weapons.description: A straight, double-edged blade favored for dual-wielding and tight corridors.

weapons.name: Warhammer
weapons.description: A heavy steel hammer with a flat striking face and a rear armor-piercing spike.

weapons.name: Heavy Crossbow
weapons.description: A high-tension steel winch crossbow with bone-shattering penetration.

weapons.name: Longbow
weapons.description: A tall yew bow capable of long-range battlefield volleys.

potions_and_consumables.name: Potion of Healing
potions_and_consumables.description: A magical red fluid that restores 2d4 + 2 hit points when consumed.

potions_and_consumables.name: Potion of Greater Healing
potions_and_consumables.description: A potent vermilion elixir restoring 4d4 + 4 hit points.

potions_and_consumables.name: Potion of Superior Healing
potions_and_consumables.description: A glowing crimson tonic restoring 8d4 + 8 hit points.

potions_and_consumables.name: Antitoxin
potions_and_consumables.description: Grants advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour.

potions_and_consumables.name: Alchemist's Fire
potions_and_consumables.description: A flask of sticky, volatile liquid that ignites upon exposure to air.

potions_and_consumables.name: Holy Water
potions_and_consumables.description: Blessed water harmful to fiends and undead.

gear_and_tools.name: Thieves' Tools
gear_and_tools.description: Lockpicks, tension wrenches, small mirrors, and fine pliers used to pick locks and disarm mechanical traps.

gear_and_tools.name: Arcane Focus (Wand)
gear_and_tools.description: A wand crafted of rune-inscribed wood used to channel arcane spells.

gear_and_tools.name: Arcane Focus (Crystal)
gear_and_tools.description: A cut gemstone humming with residual weave.

gear_and_tools.name: Holy Symbol (Amulet)
gear_and_tools.description: A consecrated emblem worn as a medallion to channel divine magic.

gear_and_tools.name: Backpack
gear_and_tools.description: A sturdy leather pack holding up to 30 pounds of equipment.

gear_and_tools.name: Hempen Rope (50 feet)
gear_and_tools.description: Fifty feet of durable braided hemp rope.

gear_and_tools.name: Torch (Bundle of 3)
gear_and_tools.description: Burns for 1 hour, providing bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

gear_and_tools.name: Rations (1 day)
gear_and_tools.description: Dry food suitable for extended travel, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts.

gear_and_tools.name: Tinderbox
gear_and_tools.description: Flint, fire steel, and tinder used to ignite a campfire or torch.

custom_campaign_items.name: Inverted Spear of Heaven
custom_campaign_items.description: A jitte dagger with a carved two-pronged blade capable of forcefully disrupting and nullifying cursed techniques.
